brief:
The West Bank experienced a rise in resistance operations during September 2026, ranging from stabbings and shootings to vehicle rammings and armed clashes, according to the Palestinian Information Center Maa'n, Shehab Wire reported. The attacks occurred across multiple locations in the occupied territory.

The escalation marks a continuation of armed confrontations between Palestinian groups and Israeli forces in the West Bank.
